title: Interpreting Physics in Video World Models
author: Sonia Joseph, Quentin Garrido, Randall Balestriero, Matthew Kowal, Thomas Fel
summary: This study looks inside video models to see how they understand physical concepts like speed and direction. It finds that physical information appears strongly in the middle layers of these models, called the Physics Emergence Zone. The models use a shared, complex way to represent physics, not simple separate variables like traditional physics engines.
